name: gemini-search
description: Web search via Gemini with Google Search grounding.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and get an answer with citations. Ask a real question rather than typing keywords — this searches Google and has a model read the results, so 'what did the Fed decide about rates this week' works better than 'fed rates'. Returns a short answer followed by its sources. Use it for anything that happened after your training cutoff, and for facts worth checking rather than recalling. It cannot open a specific URL: use web_fetch for that.

query.description: The question to answer, in natural language.

detail.description: brief (default) returns a couple of sentences; full returns a longer synthesis.

config.description: Comma-separated model preference list, tried in order. Grounding quota is per-model, so a 429 falls through to the next one.
Gemini API base URL (egress pin source of truth).
